map.根据肺量计测定数据计算 FEV1/FVC 比值，判读通气功能障碍类型及 GOLD: Computes the FEV1/FVC ratio from spirometry data to classify ventilatory defect type and GOLD severity
map.📖 查看「肺功能 FEV1/FVC 分级器 使用指南」: 📖 View the Pulmonary Function FEV1/FVC Grader user guide
map.需TLC确认，见于肺纤维化/胸壁疾病: Needs TLC confirmation; seen in pulmonary fibrosis / chest wall disease
map.📊 GOLD 阻塞性气流受限严重度（基于 FEV1%预计值）: 📊 GOLD Severity of Obstructive Airflow Limitation (based on FEV1% predicted)
map.提示：FEV1/FVC 固定阈值 0.70 对年轻人可能高估、对老年人可能低估阻: Note: the fixed 0.70 FEV1/FVC cutoff may overestimate obstruction in the young and underestimate it in the elderly; interpret together with LLN (lower limit of normal). Restrictive defects need TLC confirmation. Post-bronchodilator FEV1/FVC <0.70 indicates incompletely reversible airflow limitation (COPD). Clinical reference only.
map.比值=1.5/3.0=50%<0.7→阻塞性；FVC%pred≥80 不支持限制: Ratio = 1.5/3.0 = 50% < 0.7 -> obstructive; FVC%pred >=80 does not support restriction.
map.比值正常但 FVC%pred<80→限制性通气障碍，查 TLC。: Normal ratio but FVC%pred <80 -> restrictive defect; check TLC.
map.本工具 cutoff 可设(默认 0.7)，老年建议按 LLN。: The cutoff is configurable (default 0.7); LLN is advised for the elderly.
map.比值低且 FVC 低为混合性，需 TLC/DLCO 确认。: Low ratio plus low FVC is mixed; confirm with TLC/DLCO.
map.肺功能(FEV1/FVC)分级器，根据FEV1、FVC实测值及预计值计算FEV1: Pulmonary Function (FEV1/FVC) Grader computes the FEV1/FVC ratio from measured and predicted values, classifying obstructive/restrictive defects and GOLD grade. A medical professional tool based on authoritative medical standards, for reference only.
